data.name: Henry’s Enclosures Inc.
data.address: 4115 Vermont Ave, Lake Worth Beach, FL 33461

reviews.text:
Excellent work and service. We did a complete overhaul of our pool screen and roof attached to it. We elevated our roof/ceiling by 3 feet and it came out beautifully! Henry is a great dude.

A few weeks later a bird crashed into a corner which ripped a portion of the screen, and Henry’s team came out to repair it in 10 mins.

I highly recommend Henry services.
reviews.author: Felipe

reviews.text:
Please consider this to be an enthusiastic Five Star review of both Henry and his company.

We searched for over a year to find the right company for the demolition and replacement of our enclosure's roof, ceiling and gutter system, We couldn't be more pleased with the results.

Note as well that the work (roof and gutter replacement) was completed two weeks ago and in the  interim south Florida has received considerable rain from tropical storm Eta. We happily report no leaks . Zero.

Finally we'll echo the previous reviewers regarding Henry's pricing, professionalism and promptness and thank them as well for helping us find the right person for the job, as you will if you choose Henry.
reviews.author: Michael Conrad

reviews.text: Henry is so great!! He replaced the screening on our rather large pool enclosure in about a day (rain forced them to stop and come back next morning). We're thrilled with the quality of work, material, and customer service we received. We cannot recommend Henry's Enclosures enough!
reviews.author: Cheryl Postorino

reviews.text: Team Rey and Sebastian did an amazing Job in my house. Kept me in the loop with the entire re-screening process and as they advanced the job. They did a very professional job and kept me informed at all times! Great people! Including Henry of course!
reviews.author: Hector B. Arias

reviews.text: I am so pleased with my new screens on my enclosed patio. The two guys who were here worked so diligently and tirelessly. I felt that Henry wanted to make sure I was happy with everything he did, and he made sure I was. Wonderful company to work with.
reviews.author: Helene Kaplan

reviews.text: Henry's Enclosures did an excellent job in creating a screened enclosure for our outside patio area. Henry took the time to discuss our needs with us and recommended what he thought would be best for our location. He exceeded all of our expectations and even custom painted the enclosure to match our walls. The screens are of high quality and we are delighted that you hardly notice that they are there. His workers were very neat, very skilled and on time. We give him 5 Stars and highly recommend his service. Thank you Henry and crew.
reviews.author: Denise Lamberti

reviews.text: Henry’s Enclosures came and repaired our Backyard Patio that was just rotting away. Henry came and gave us a free estimate and made a professional computer drawing of our project. The project drawing was exactly what we wanted to feel confident moving forward. The price was fair, great quality materials and the craftsmanship is excellent! The crew paid a lot of attention to detail and completely exceeded our expectations. Great crew of guys that I would 100% hire again!!
reviews.author: Briana Caterino

reviews.text:
Very professional company.
I want to thanks Henry’s and your crew for a amazing job I really appreciate it.
Thank you guys.
reviews.author: Tony Hernandez
